answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one concrete mechanism: each identity must lock a refundable bond held per-account and slashed on proof of collusion. Running thousands of fake agents means posting that bond thousands of times, so an attacker's capital outlay scales linearly while extractable reward stays flat, pushing the horizon of profit far out. Each duplicate must also clear an attestation threshold from independent graders, and every forged vertex in the trust graph raises detection odds. Stake sits in basalt-hard escrow, not cheap signatures.
